Shelter-k2 sounds
=================

Upstream project: shelter-k2 0.0.4
Author: zanven
Project URL: https://github.com/zanven42/factorio-shelter-k2
License: GNU General Public License v3.0

The Cave imports only the Shelter open/close sounds. Beginning with The Cave
3.1.67, the exterior Shelter artwork, remnant artwork, inventory/shortcut icon,
light and shadow layers are no longer imported from shelter-k2. The upstream
runtime logic and its free 120 kW power output are not included. The full
upstream GPL-3.0 license remains included beside this notice as
shelter-k2-GPL-3.0.txt.
